definition_evidence.summary: The model identifies EDHREC rank/saltiness, official card rulings, and provider product/SKU relationships.
Oracle and Printing aliases are Scryfall-generated identifiers; other identifiers refer to named provider namespaces.
The model describes foreign printed content and language-specific metadata, including MTGJSON-generated UUIDs.

provenance_and_derived_fields: Candidate IDs/hashes, field provenance, source URLs, timestamps, parsed references, normalization, confidence, review states and checksums are internal transformations or acquisition observations. Their existence does not license the source content they bind. Exact-record PLST projection and MB2 sealed-product projection remain immutable retained dependencies. Original membership and emblem packets remain historical; Essence of Ajani is outside the ordinary candidate set.

scryfall_factual_projection.scope: 273 cross-checks retained; 270 ordinary candidate identities selected; no card images, prices or Oracle prose in this projection
scryfall_factual_projection.upstream_or_origin: Scryfall identifiers/API URIs and catalog encodings combined with Wizards card names, type lines and printed-product facts

upstream_gap_scope: No blanket grant is claimed in metrics, other providers identifier compilations, or underlying text; exact per-field sublicensing and operation applicability remain unresolved. Mere IDs, links and credit facts are not treated as artwork or automatically copyrighted prose.
